2125264654754849180.en_summary: $SPX 7250 remains the bigger line in the sand into month end with the big 30,000 put position expiring Dec 31 there as a large hedge. That put is a 53 delta now slightly ITM and worth $230 each contract or $700M (was worth more Friday though). Customer still holding that long put so if or when they roll or close that would be a market moving event to upside. No reason to think they will this week but its on watch. Otherwise if SPX stays below 7250 it increases that positions gamma exposure into December. Often when giant ITM puts close its the signal you want as a bigger market reversal having legs to last more than a day or two.
2125264654754849180.zh_summary: $SPX 7250 仍是月底前更大的沙中之線，有大額 30,000 張看跌期權倉位將於 12 月 31 日到期作為大型對沖。該看跌期權現在是 53 delta，略微價內，每份合約價值 230 美元或總計 7 億美元（上週五價值更高）。客戶仍持有該長倉看跌期權，因此如果或當他們滾動或平倉時將是向上的市場移動事件。沒有理由認為他們本週會這樣做，但正在觀察。否則如果 SPX 維持在 7250 以下，將增加該倉位進入十二月的 gamma 暴露。通常當巨型價內看跌期權平倉時，這是你想要的信號，作為更大市場反轉有腿持續超過一兩天。
